summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Admin Selection Import (Hasil Wawancara & Kelulusan Akhir). 8/8 pytest tests pass covering XLSX validation, flexible-header matching by ID CPM, review kinds (mismatch/new/invalid), status upgrades (verifikasi_faktual and lolos), selection_progress notifications, history listing, audit XLSX download, dismissal endpoint (200 then 404 idempotency), and student RBAC (403 on GET/POST/DELETE for imports, review, history, download). Frontend flow validated end-to-end via admin login: menu-import-seleksi opens the SelectionImportManager, 2 stage options present, all required data-testids exist (upload-button, file-input, review-panel, history, review-tab, new-imported-tab), file upload returns summary card, 'Peserta Baru dari Import' tab shows the new participant with correct details, Riwayat Import row displays filename + summary + Unduh File button, and dismiss action triggers success toast 'Data dihapus dari daftar tinjauan.'
critical_code_review_comments: server.py list_participants performs N+1 queries (one profile + one document count per registration) — fine for current volume but should be batched with $in / aggregation for scalability.

AI helpers ai_import_mapping and ai_review_notes use gemini-3.1-pro-preview and swallow exceptions silently; ensure logs are surfaced in production monitoring since deterministic mapping already provides a solid fallback.
Selection import endpoint stores raw uploaded XLSX in object storage but there is no retention/cleanup policy documented; consider a scheduled cleanup or note privacy retention window.
seed_data_creation: No new seed users created. Test uses existing 50 seeded participants (student_uji_mdj_XXX). Test-created selection_imports and selection_import_review rows (filename prefix 'test-selection-import-') and any modified seed statuses are rolled back at end of pytest and post-UI test via direct pymongo cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Selection Import feature (Hasil Wawancara & Kelulusan Akhir) is fully functional end-to-end. Regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_selection_import.py (8 tests). Note test suite must be invoked with -n0 because /app/backend/pytest.ini enables xdist by default. UI test uses /tmp/test-selection-import-ui.xlsx which is regenerated on demand. Object-storage audit files are not deleted by cleanup (as noted by main agent) — only the DB rows are removed so UI stops showing them.
